description: Backfill Item.consumptionAllowed default for pre-existing items
issue: #23995 — Consumption/Disposal Issue item search hides ~92% of pharmacy stock
author: Dr M H B Ariyaratne
note: Item.consumptionAllowed (added commit edcde8f9, Nov 2025) is a Java primitive defaulting to true, but that initializer has no effect on the SQL column default. When the column was added via generate-ddl to a table with existing rows, MySQL backfilled them to 0 (false) instead of true, and none are NULL, so the query's 'OR consumptionAllowed IS NULL' legacy fallback never fires. This silently hides almost all pre-existing pharmacy stock from Consumption/Disposal Issue item search. This migration backfills CONSUMPTIONALLOWED=1 for items currently at 0, restoring the intended default. No application code change needed. Affected item IDs are recorded into migration_v2180_consumption_allowed_item_ids so rollback.sql can revert exactly those rows without touching items deliberately restricted later via the AMP toggle.
